title: How big must an atom be before its filling rule breaks? Introductory text to Where the $n+l$ rule breaks in the Thomas-Fermi atom: certified zero-energy thresholds, Madelung order through $n+l=10$, and the first overlap at $n+l=11$
description: A plain-language introduction to a research paper on where the n+l filling rule first breaks in the Thomas-Fermi atom. The paper has the proofs; this note has the idea, and it says what the paper does and does not claim.
